description: This file contains private function declarations and macros for the FreeType font rendering library, specifically for the base module. It includes function prototypes for opening font faces from streams and buffers, as well as platform-specific resource fork handling.

methods.name: open_face_PS_from_sfnt_stream
methods.description: Loads a font face from an SFNT-wrapped PostScript Type1 or CID-keyed font stream.

methods.name: open_face_from_buffer
methods.description: Creates a new font face from a memory buffer and driver name.

methods.name: ft_raccess_rule_by_darwin_vfs
methods.description: Determines resource fork access rules on Mac OS X/Darwin systems based on VFS.
